过年休息三天。

腊月二十九那天，学校就放了假。教导员在队务会上说了，外地路远的，回不了家的，留在学校过年，三十晚上食堂加菜，初一还有晚会。家里离得近的——天津的、河北的、北京本地的——基本上全部都请假回家了。王建新也早早收拾好东西，准备回家过年。

他请了假，教导员批得痛快：“你家就在北京，不回去说不过去。去吧，初三晚上回来就行。”

王建新出了校门，坐上公交车。快过年了，街上的人比平时多，都大包小包地拎着东西，脸上带着过年的喜气。车窗外的店铺门口贴上了红纸对联，供销社的橱窗里摆着年画，有胖娃娃抱鲤鱼，有工农兵高举红旗，红红绿绿的，看着就热闹。

公交车晃了将近一个小时，到了他家附近的站。王建新下了车，街上冷飕飕的，但太阳挺好，照在身上有点暖意。他拐进一条胡同，找了个没人的角落，从空间里取出一大块猪肉、一大块羊肉，都是冻得硬邦邦的，用油纸包着。又拎了一网兜新鲜蔬菜——西红柿、黄瓜和茄子，空间里种的，水灵灵的，看着就喜人。又拿出两条大前门，一条中华。

东西不少，猪肉羊肉加起来得有二十来斤，蔬菜也十来斤，再加上三条烟，手里拎得满满当当的。他深吸一口气，拎着东西走进了大杂院。

“建新回来啦？”前院的王大妈正在门口贴春联，看见他，眼睛一亮，“哎呦，拎这么多东西，这是把供销社搬回来了？”

“王大妈过年好。”王建新笑着打了个招呼，往里走。

中院的刘婶正在院子里杀鸡，手里拎着一只大公鸡，鸡毛飞了一地。看见王建新，嗓门大得很：“建新，你妈念叨你一上午了，快进去吧！”

王建新一路打着招呼，进了后院。全家人都在，开开心心地准备午饭。大哥王建国蹲在门口劈柴，斧头抡得高，落得准，木柴“咔”一声裂成两半。大嫂刘兰兰在厨房里洗菜，袖子卷到胳膊肘，手冻得通红。母亲李凤兰在切肉，刀在案板上当当当的，节奏又快又匀。父亲王世昌坐在堂屋里扒葱剥蒜。二哥王建军在擦桌子，把八仙桌擦得锃亮。小妹丽丽陪小丫头妞妞玩耍。

“三哥！”丽丽第一个看见王建新，跑过来，一把抱住他的腰。

妞妞听见动静，扭头看见小叔，立马也小跑着过来，抱住了三叔的大腿。

大哥王建国放下斧头，赶忙过来帮忙接东西。他接过那大块猪肉，手一沉，嘴里“嚯”了一声：“这么重？三儿，你这是把一年的供应都搬回来了？”

王建新跟着大哥进了堂屋，把手里的东西一样一样地放在桌上。猪肉、羊肉、蔬菜、香烟，摆了一桌子。

父亲看着桌上那一堆东西，皱了皱眉：“从哪弄这么多东西？”

王建新笑着说：“跟着老师学习，医术进步很快。前段时间给一位老首长看病，结果看好了，获了个二等功，这不是人家给的奖励吗？还有我的军票买的一些。”

他从兜里又掏出一小沓北京地方票据——肉票、蛋票、糖票、肥皂票、豆腐票，花花绿绿的，递给父亲。

“这是我剩下的票据，兑换的本地票。都快过期的票，爸，你们拿上，抓紧时间赶紧用。过期就可惜了。”

父亲接过票，一张一张地翻看，嘴里念叨着：“肉票五斤，蛋票三斤，糖票两斤……这可不少。三儿，你自己不留点？”

“我在学校吃得挺好的，用不上这些。你们在家用。”

母亲从厨房探出头来，看见桌上那堆东西，嘴上却说：“又乱花钱。你那点工资，都花家里了。”

“妈，没花多少钱。您就放心用吧。”

王建新又问二哥：“二哥，你找的那个对象定了没？多会结婚？”

二哥王建军挠挠头，笑得有点不好意思：“基本上定了。爸妈说过完年，四月初定好日子，再通知你。”

“二哥，有啥需要的东西和我说，我从部队想办法调剂一下。”

Take three days off during the Chinese New Year.

On the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth lunar month, school was on holiday.The instructor said at the team meeting that those who are far away from home and cannot return home should stay in school to celebrate the New Year. There will be extra food in the cafeteria on the 30th night, and there will be a party on the first day of junior high school.Those who live close to home - those in Tianjin, Hebei, and local Beijing - basically all took leave and went home.Wang Jianxin also packed his things early and prepared to go home for the New Year.

He asked for leave, and the instructor approvingly said, "Your home is in Beijing. It makes no sense not to go back. Go ahead and come back in the evening of the third year of junior high school."

Wang Jianxin left the school and got on the bus.The Chinese New Year is coming soon, and there are more people on the street than usual, all carrying large and small bags with New Year's joy on their faces.Red paper couplets were pasted on the door of the shop outside the car window, and New Year pictures were displayed in the window of the supply and marketing cooperative. There were fat dolls holding carps, and workers, peasants and soldiers holding red flags high. They were red and green, and it was lively just to look at them.

The bus drove for nearly an hour and arrived at the stop near his home.Wang Jianxin got out of the car. It was chilly on the street, but the sun was shining brightly, and it felt a little warm on his body.He turned into an alley, found a deserted corner, and took out a large piece of pork and a large piece of mutton from the space. They were both frozen hard and wrapped in oil paper.I also carried a bag of fresh vegetables—tomatoes, cucumbers, and eggplants. They were grown in the space, and they looked juicy and pleasing to the eye.He also took out two large front doors and one Chinese one.

There was a lot of stuff, the total amount of pork and mutton was about twenty kilograms, and vegetables were also about ten kilograms. Plus three cartons of cigarettes, my hand was full.He took a deep breath and walked into the courtyard carrying his things.

"Jianxin is back?" Aunt Wang in the front yard was posting Spring Festival couplets at the door. When she saw him, her eyes lit up, "Oh, you are carrying so many things, are you moving the supply and marketing cooperative back?"

"Happy New Year, Aunt Wang." Wang Jianxin greeted with a smile and walked inside.

Aunt Liu in the middle courtyard was killing chickens in the yard. She was holding a big rooster in her hand, and the feathers flew all over the floor.When he saw Wang Jianxin, he shouted loudly: "Jianxin, your mother has been talking about you all morning, come in quickly!"

Wang Jianxin greeted everyone and entered the backyard.The whole family is here, happily preparing lunch.The eldest brother Wang Jianguo squatted at the door to chop wood. He swung the ax high and landed accurately, and the wood split into two with a "click".Sister-in-law Liu Lanlan was washing vegetables in the kitchen, her sleeves rolled up to her elbows, and her hands were red from the cold.Mother Li Fenglan was cutting meat, the knife clanking on the chopping board, the rhythm was fast and even.My father, Wang Shichang, was sitting in the main room peeling onions and garlic.The second brother Wang Jianjun was cleaning the table, making the Eight Immortals table shiny.Little sister Lili plays with little girl Niuniu.

"Third brother!" Lili was the first to see Wang Jianxin, ran over and hugged his waist.

Niu Niu heard the noise and turned around to see her uncle. She immediately ran over and hugged her third uncle's thigh.

The eldest brother Wang Jianguo put down his ax and hurried over to help pick up the things.He took the large piece of pork, his hand sank, and he made a sound in his mouth: "Is it so heavy? San'er, are you bringing back a year's supply?"

Wang Jianxin followed his elder brother into the main room and put everything in his hands on the table.Pork, mutton, vegetables, and cigarettes were laid out on a table.

Father looked at the pile of things on the table and frowned: "Where did you get so many things?"

Wang Jianxin said with a smile: "I have made rapid progress in my medical skills by studying with my teacher. I treated an old chief some time ago, and the result was promising, and I won a second-class merit. Isn't this a reward given by others? I also bought some with my military tickets."

He took out a small stack of Beijing local receipts from his pocket - meat stamps, egg stamps, candy stamps, soap stamps, tofu stamps, all colorful, and handed them to his father.

"This is the remaining ticket I exchanged for a local ticket. The ticket is about to expire. Dad, take it and use it as soon as possible. It would be a pity if it expires."

The father took the tickets and looked through them one by one, muttering: "Five catties of meat tickets, three catties of egg tickets, two catties of candy tickets... That's a lot. San'er, don't you keep some for yourself?"

"I eat very well at school, so I don't need these. You use them at home."

My mother poked her head out of the kitchen and saw the pile of things on the table, but she said, "You spend money randomly again. All your salary is spent on the family."

"Mom, it doesn't cost much. Just feel free to use it."

Wang Jianxin asked his second brother again: "Second brother, have you decided on the person you are looking for? How soon will you get married?"

The second brother Wang Jianjun scratched his head and smiled a little sheepishly: "It's basically decided. My parents have said that after the New Year, we will set a date in early April and let you know."

"Second brother, tell me if you need anything, and I'll find a way to arrange it from the army."
